'''Bering''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who used the skin of a [[croator]] to survive on [[Wyndigal 2]]. By the time he was rescued, he was sunburnt, feverish, and had suffered hallucinations.<ref name="Survival by Any Means" />
